phase: slices 1-3 pushed (afcfec2, 19fb4f3, 66c900b): smart animate engine; Folio overlay records + .fig overlay mapping + player overlays; harness play-mode tween render + overlay placement

commits.subject: harness (SMB-FIG-SMART-ANIMATE slice 3): play mode renders smart animate as a layer tween and places overlays
components (SMB-FIG-SMART-ANIMATE slice 1): smart animate layer matching and interpolation
folio + interop-fig + components (SMB-FIG-SMART-ANIMATE slice 2): overlay records from .fig and player overlays

capabilities_done: (1) components::smart_animate: match_layers pairs two frame snapshots by name path (ancestor names up to the top-level frame, same depth, index among same-named siblings); implicit (autoRename) text layers match by text style with the nearest x/y; interpolate tweens position, size, rotation (shortest arc), opacity, RGBA fill and corner radius at the eased progress (back-easing overshoot extrapolates geometry, clamps opacity/colour, size/radius >= 0); smart_animate_frame draws source-only layers beneath dissolving out, destination-only dissolving in (outermost unmatched layer only), matched layers with changed content cross-dissolved in place; ActiveTransition.match_layers set for SMART_ANIMATE and directional match_layers; bounded (MAX_SMART_LAYERS, MAX_SMART_DEPTH), typed refusals for dangling parent, cycle, duplicate id, non-finite props

(2) Folio StudioDesignRecords.frame_overlay: StudioFrameOverlay {node, overlay_position_type (8 values, absent = unset = CENTER), overlay_background NONE | SOLID_COLOR{StudioRgba}, overlay_background_interaction NONE | CLOSE_ON_CLICK_OUTSIDE}, serde-default + skipped when empty (byte-identical, test prototype_records_contract::overlay_records_round_trip_and_keep_empty_sets_identical); validation refuses dangling/duplicate entries, bad colours and STU-PRO-154 (OVERLAY to a MANUAL frame without overlay_relative_position). interop-fig decodes overlayPositionType, overlayBackgroundAppearance, overlayBackgroundInteraction, node/action overlayRelativePosition and text autoRename (were field_not_decoded losses) and maps them (precision 2; unknown tokens, missing MANUAL position (origin used) and a position on a non-overlay navigation are typed losses). components player: overlay_positions per open overlay, overlay_config, overlay_placement (8 positions + MANUAL), click_outside_overlay (CLOSE_ON_CLICK_OUTSIDE)

(3) harness play mode (src/view/prototype.rs): a match_layers transition renders the in-between frame as a real tween: smart_frame snapshots both top-level frames from the .fig nodes (parent-relative position, size, rotation from the transform, opacity, first solid fill, corner radius, autoRename text style, text/image content), components pairs and interpolates at the eased progress, smart_document writes a synthetic .fig copy (destination nodes moved/resized with geometry scaled, rounded rectangles rebuilt at the interpolated radius, fills/opacity set; source-only layers and outgoing changed content cloned beneath, dissolving) rendered through to_native + PDF frame export + press (single-slot cache per progress point); other transitions keep the eased cross-fade. Overlays placed by overlay_placement from the frame record + action position, drawn over the SOLID_COLOR overlay background; an outside click closes a CLOSE_ON_CLICK_OUTSIDE overlay and reaches nothing else; PrototypePlay::open_document / document(); state_json reports overlay_positions and match_layers

notes.spec_basis: STU-PRO-117 'SMART_ANIMATE is the layer-matching tween; matching is by (layer name, position in the child hierarchy) — the SAME pairing rule as instance override matching ([STU-DS-119]) — and it tweens position, size, rotation, opacity and fill, fading unmatched layers'; STU-PRO-118 'match_layers (boolean, default false) applies the smart-animate pairing of [STU-PRO-117] on top of the directional move'; STU-PRO-018 'Smart-animate MUST pair layers across origin and destination frames by name and hierarchy and tween position, size, rotation, opacity, and fill differences, fading unmatched layers'; STU-PRO-122 'Overlay fields live on the destination frame ... overlay_position_type, overlay_background, overlay_background_interaction'; STU-PRO-123 'Exactly nine values of overlay_position_type ... the implicit unset state which resolves to CENTER. MANUAL requires overlay_relative_position = {x, y} on the action, in document units, precision 2'; STU-PRO-124 overlay_background NONE | SOLID_COLOR{color}, interaction NONE | CLOSE_ON_CLICK_OUTSIDE; STU-PRO-154 overlay_manual_position_missing (error)
notes.figma_reading: Figma help center (read 2026-10-15): 360039818874 'Smart animate layers between frames' (matching uses the layer name and where it sits in the hierarchy; animates position, scale, opacity, rotation, fill; new layers dissolve into view) and 21523793229463 'Identify matching objects' (same layer name; implicitly named text layers match by text style, best match by x and y; all ancestor frames must have matching names, top-level frame names need not; same position in the hierarchy; duplicate names use the index within the parent). Corner radius tweening is a lane requirement, not stated by Figma's page. Figma parity of all of it UNVERIFIED (D5).
notes.unverified: Figma's exact nearest-x/y text tie-break, rotation path (Studio: shortest arc), draw order of dissolving layers, treatment of changed text content (Studio: in-place cross-dissolve)
notes.measured: harness mid frame (175 of 350 ms, EASE_IN_AND_OUT eased 0.5) vs reference blend (orb colour inside the tweened disc, background inside the end discs, eased cross-fade elsewhere; 1.5 px disc edges skipped): n 184672, mean 0.096560/255, 99.7195 % within 8/255; 5924 orb pixels all exactly [51,115,230]; old/new orb centres show background, a cross-fade would show a half-faded orb there (>60/255 off). Fixture pairing: only animated-orb pairs (24,100 70x70 -> 200,150 110x110; midpoint 112,125 90x90 exact); its text layers store autoRename=false with different names, so they dissolve
notes.not_proven: decode of real .fig overlay bytes: the Operator prototype fixture stores no overlay fields (census lists none); the mapping is proven on decoded nodes edited in the test (interop-fig tests/fig_smart_animate.rs, harness overlays_are_placed_by_their_frame_records_and_close_on_click_outside). Field names come from the fixture's own Kiwi schema (NodeChange.overlayPositionType, overlayBackgroundInteraction, overlayBackgroundAppearance{backgroundType, backgroundColor}, overlayRelativePosition; PrototypeAction.overlayRelativePosition)
